applicabilityBasis.summary: cNGN is a Nigerian-naira token redeemable 1:1 against naira reserves and marketed as a settlement rail, so it is an apparent payment stablecoin for GENIUS-scope review.

genius.licensingRegulator: Securities and Exchange Commission Nigeria; Accelerated Regulatory Incubation Programme admission announced July 2, 2026. The SEC states admitted entities would receive conditional Approval-in-Principle, not a final licence.
genius.notes: Nigeria SEC admission to ARIP is not a final licence or a U.S. GENIUS authorization. The July 2 SEC announcement says admitted entities would receive conditional Approval-in-Principle. No public GENIUS approval, state qualification, official application, issuer-announced GENIUS pathway, OCC foreign registration or Treasury comparability determination was located for WrappedCBDC/cNGN. The public transparency page describes monthly reserve audits, and an actual August 31, 2026 ISAE 3000 reserve examination by Bala Isah Garba and Company was opened: NGN 3,550,845,048.39 reserve assets exceeded NGN 3,329,961,223.91 token liabilities. Its local regulatory-compliance discussion is not evidence of U.S. approval. Foreign-exception status remains unknown and the general GENIUS DASP restriction is not yet effective.
